countingRule: Counts use only original Node-active titles; pending titles remain outside the denominator. Only the dedicated assertion marker is failed. Typed lowering/runtime refusals and other native ABAP exceptions are trapped; unsupported async/done and not-run remain separate. Infrastructure failures never manufacture test results. Refusal-body impacts may overlap and are not operation-execution counts.
codeCommitScope: codeCommit is the base used by parts 01-09; parts 10-12 use codeCommits.parts10to12, which cherry-picks 342d9f3.

partitionAudit.method: Original-file roots are disjoint and exhaustive. Fresh partition Node title multisets (including multiplicity) equal the independent full rules oracle, separately for all, active, failed and pending titles; each measured partition nodeTotal also matches its oracle.
